episodes.synopsis: Pressure is at an all time high as the ladies of KOTOBUKI Flight Corps fend off more than just air pirates in the air and on land.
episodes.title: Moonlit Guns for Hire

episodes.synopsis: The squad’s R&R is interrupted when they receive a new mission for triple the regular pay! It’s an opportunity too good to pass up, but does this mean triple the danger?
episodes.title: The Wandering Six

episodes.synopsis: The town of Rachma refuses to sell the Raiden, a powerful fighter plane. Elite Industries won't accept "no" for an answer. Now, our intrepid heroines must fight back.
episodes.title: Rachma's Longest Day

episodes.synopsis: The squad must somehow infiltrate Elite Industries’ stronghold. Fortunately, a traveling tavern gives Zara a sudden idea.
episodes.title: Elite Stronghold

episodes.synopsis: Julia fundamentally disagrees with an idealistic and influential man named Isao. But he apparently has a plan to deal with both the air pirates and the energy crisis.
episodes.title: The Splendid Aleshma

episodes.synopsis: When a solo mission goes horribly awry, Kylie’s skills as a pilot are put to the ultimate test.
episodes.title: No Place to Return

episodes.synopsis: Most people rely on water to put out fires, but using a bomb to douse an inferno? Only the KOTOBUKI Flight Corps could think up a stunt like that!
episodes.title: Blood for a Nazarin Pound

episodes.synopsis: The KOTOBUKI Flight Corps must transport a rare fish across the skies, but when their mission makes newspaper headlines, air pirates come calling to claim the valuable cargo.
episodes.title: The Great Airship Robbery

episodes.synopsis: Kylie promises to stay out of trouble when her plane is grounded for repairs. Too bad a scenic flight with Allen in a training plane lands her in hot water…
episodes.title: The Vagabond Toddler

episodes.synopsis: Join the Brotherhood of Freedom Union or be bombed into oblivion? Not if the KOTOBUKI Flight Corps has anything to say about it!
episodes.title: The Aggressive Bombers

episodes.synopsis: Dog fight? No, it’s a dog WAR as the KOTOBUKI Flight Corps joins the aerial assault on Isao’s forces and Ikesuka!
episodes.title: Duel in Ikesuka

episodes.synopsis: Bravery. Chutzpah. Derring-do. The KOTOBUKI Flight Corps will need all that and more as the battle in the skies over Ikesuka soars to its thrilling conclusion!
episodes.title: Kotobuki of the Setting Sun
